entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maurício Borges Almeida Silva is a Brazilian professional volleyball player who plays as an outside hitter for Vôlei Renata. He is a former member of the Brazil national team, the 2016 Olympic Champion, a silver medallist at the 2014 World Championship, and the 2019 World Cup winner. He also competed for Brazil at the 2020 Summer Olympics.
